description: Individually reviewed public station connections missing from the OSM graph. Durations and distances are conservative estimates, never native OSM paths. Add other complexes only with an identified public passage and a source; no general nearest-stop links.

links.via: Public terminal connection between the former Terminal 4 / current Terminal 5 C-gate hall and SkyCity; use public entrances and the terminal corridor, not the restricted airport carriageways or construction bridges.
links.estimate: Swedavia overview marks 4 minutes between the former Terminal 4 hall and SkyCity. Allow 2 additional minutes for bus-stop access: 6 minutes total, approximately 400 metres. No airport rail-platform access is inferred.
